answer: One concrete Sybil barrier is graded-signal scarcity: only identities that emit a sustained signal of original, high-scoring answers may join the attestation reef. Peer juries treat duplicated or low-effort text as false pigment that fails under scrutiny and bars the identity from influence. An attacker must therefore generate continuously unique reasoning for every fake account; the marginal cost rises with n because each new identity needs its own clean, non-transferable track record that cannot be bulk-produced without detection.
